Product ticket:
# Product ticket: expiry handling

## Background
Inventory items should be marked for handling based on expiry dates.

## Happy path
- Items expiring today should be handled.
- Items expiring tomorrow should not be handled by default.

## Policy note
Some categories have lead-time rules.

## Acceptance criteria
- Expiring today returns handle_today true.
- Invalid dates return an error.

public_spec:
Title: Expiry handling with lead time - should_handle_today

Behavior requirements:
- should_handle_today(item) returns true when the item expiry date is today
- should_handle_today(item) returns false for expiry dates tomorrow (unless lead-time rules apply for the item's category)
- Invalid or missing expiry dates should raise an error
- Lead-time rules, when present for a category, influence whether an item is considered for handling on a given day
- Function adheres to authorization and access control where applicable

Edge cases:
- Expiry date is today with time zone differences; ensure date comparison is based on the canonical local date
- Expiry date is null or malformed; results in an error
- Category has a lead-time rule that changes the handling decision (e.g., lead-time = 2 days) and the expiry is today or tomorrow accordingly
- Leap year and end-of-month transitions
- Multiple items with the same expiry date are processed idempotently

Acceptance criteria:
- Expiring today returns handle_today = true
- Expiring tomorrow returns handle_today = false by default, unless a lead-time rule applies that changes this
- Invalid dates return an error
- Lead-time rules are consulted for applicable categories
- State updates and audit logging occur as part of decision evaluation where relevant

Non-goals:
- Implementing full inventory mutation on decision; this spec covers only the boolean decision function
- Handling cross-tenant data leakage; assume proper isolation in surrounding layer

Testable assertions:
- should_handle_today(expiry_today) == true
- should_handle_today(expiry_tomorrow) == false with no lead-time rule
- should_handle_today(expiry_tomorrow) == true if category lead-time indicates processing on that day
- should_handle_today(null_expiry) raises an error
- should_handle_today(invalid_date) raises an error
